caption: The drawing depicts three objects arranged horizontally on a plain, light beige background. The leftmost object is a slender, ornate, gold-colored tool with a pointed, flat metal tip resembling a pen nib. The central object is similar in structure, also gold-colored, but its tip is a thin, curved metal wire. The rightmost object displays the end view of the tool, showing a circular red top on a short, gold cylindrical base. All objects are vertical, slightly separated from each other, and have intricate detailing around the upper part just below the red circular top. The drawing includes the inscription "JOHN. H. TERCUZZI." in the lower left corner.
title: Toothpick
